title: Consolidate the near-duplicate chart_data_service test files spawned across fix waves
rule: Fowler duplication / AG-5 (one mirrored test suite per source file)

why: chart_data_service.dart (697 lines) is covered by FIVE test files totalling ~1,643 lines, and two independent near-duplicate pairs formed inside that set. extended_test.dart and extra_test.dart both claim to add getTargetLine coverage and reimplement the same five cases (null-no-goal, null-no-targetDate, zero-days, happy-path length, monotonic-increase) with their own copies of the same setUp/insertGoal helpers. migration_test.dart and sentinel_test.dart both re-verify the identical W1-B trackAchievement-tier behavior (bulkInTrack charted, lifetimeOnly excluded, live+bulk mixed) for the same two methods, down to near-identical doc-comment framing of the same fix wave. Each pair has exactly one genuinely unique case (extra_test's baselineCount-excludes-pre-goal-completions; sentinel_test's sentinel-timestamp-without-import-record test). This is fix-wave churn: a coverage request spawned a new file instead of extending the existing suite, so the service now needs two files edited in lockstep for the same behavior and the copies can silently drift apart.
recommendation: Fold extra_test.dart's one unique case into chart_data_service_extended_test.dart and delete extra_test.dart; fold sentinel_test.dart's sentinel-timestamp case into chart_data_service_migration_test.dart and delete sentinel_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: chart_data_service has at most 3 test files after consolidation.
The two currently-unique cases (baselineCount-excludes-pre-goal completions; sentinel-without-import treated as live) still exist and pass in the retained files.
No expect( count regresses across the merge (TQ-7 ratchet).

corrections: chart_data_service actually has 7 test files totaling 2276 lines, not '5... ~1,643' as claimed (that total silently excludes chart_data_service_w1b_test.dart, 633 lines, and omits chart_data_service_test.dart/recent_activity_test.dart from the file count). w1b_test.dart duplicates the identical 'bulkInTrack charted, lifetimeOnly excluded' W1-B behavior tested in migration_test.dart and sentinel_test.dart — a third overlapping file the finding never mentions. Consequently the acceptance criterion 'at most 3 test files after consolidation' is unreachable via the stated fix (deleting only extra_test.dart and sentinel_test.dart leaves 5 files, not 3).
